description: Add a durable Oban worker and cron entry for proactive timeline reviews. Scheduled runs must use review or proposal-only behavior and must never bypass the protocol write guard or directly publish a like. Use unique incomplete-job protection, bounded retries, and the existing SQLite scan lease. Expose schedule and last-run health in the inspection data. Acceptance: cron inserts one eligible job; overlapping jobs do not run concurrently; retries keep the same bounded review semantics; a failed review releases its scan lease; reactive, member, and friend schedules remain unchanged.
title: Schedule safe proactive reviews with Oban
